name: GMR Airports Ltd
about: GMR Infrastructure is mainly engaged in development, maintenance and operation of airports, generation of power, coal mining and exploration activities, development of highways, development, maintenance and operation of special economic zones, and construction business including Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) contracting activities.(Source : 201903 Annual Report Page No: 145)
keyPoints:
Leading Airports Platform
The company is the largest private airport operator in India, the largest in Asia, and the second-largest globally. It ranks 9th in terms of the number of airport assets under operation or in various stages of development. In FY24, it held a 27% share of passenger traffic in India. [1] [2]
